Ruby on Rails is part of 1 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2014.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1).

Most recently: [gooddata\_rails\_app](@/work/gooddata-rails-app.md): GoodData as Rails Application.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Ruby on Rails: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic.
